title: Sharper Look
notes: The update notice now sits at the very top in the middle. Everything else moves down while it is shown, so nothing overlaps.
New character look: shaded bodies lit in your power's color, glowing energy lines, a second coat tail, a katana guard, glowing eye trails and rising aura flames.
Balancing for Breaker Crystals: crystals charge a bit faster, Arena hunters are weaker, Gate D is slightly easier.
